learning_outcomes.text: Explains measurement and basic unit systems
Performs operations related to vector quantities.
Defines the concepts of position, displacement, velocity and acceleration related to motion.
Examines the motion of an object in 1, 2 or 3 dimensions.
Understand the basic equations of motion with constant acceleration.
Understand the inertial properties of objects and Newton's laws of motion and how to use them.
Explains the concepts of work, kinetic energy, potential energy and conservation of mechanical energy.
Explains the concepts of impulse, momentum and collision.

syllabus_topics: Newton's Laws of Motion and Their Applications
Newton's Laws of Motion and Their Applications
Potential Energy and Conservation of Energy
